_about: Sir James George Frazer (1854-1941), comparative religion and anthropology. The Golden Bough, a study in magic and religion, third edition (Macmillan, 1906-1915), complete in twelve volumes from Project Gutenberg; the first edition, The Golden Bough, a study in comparative religion (1890, 2 vols.), also from Gutenberg, since the third is a different and much larger book; The Belief in Immortality and the Worship of the Dead, vols. I and II (vol. III is not on Gutenberg); Psyche's Task. The 1922 one-volume abridgement is on the adler shelf (PG 3623) and is not repeated; PG 12261 is the same text as vol. X here and is not taken. His Greek writing is on the frazer-greece shelf, which left The Golden Bough out of its classical scope; this shelf takes it up as philosophy of religion. US public domain. No uids minted.
